The '''Organa Air Cavalry''' were a military unit loyal to the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]], during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> three members of the unit were deployed to aid Republic forces in reclaiming [[Fort Orrus]], a Organa stronghold [[Assault on Fort Orrus|captured]] by the rival Great [[House of Thul]] during the War. Three solders deployed from above the stronghold, using ropes to descend into battle and then fought alongside the Republic forces in engaging and [[Death/Legends|killing]] the [[General/Legends|general]] leading the Thul troops, [[Varus Thul]], and a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] named [[Serrok]], who had been sent to aid the Thul troops in battle by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Organa Air Cavalry first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. They arrived to aid the player in the final fight in the quest "Reclaiming Ft. Orrus" and it is possible for any or all of the three to die in the fight.
